# Preserved upstream license and notice texts

AstrBot commit e5e21b71aec5642f110eb115eb8e9a0d8028b7e5 declares AGPL-3.0-or-later in pyproject.toml; its root AGPLv3 text is preserved without modification. Hermes commit 9e01b44dd23978f9ff40b7837467f3a9f1582130 declares MIT; its root license and Nous Research copyright notice are preserved without modification.

Files ending upstream-notice.md preserve AstrBot project statements as provenance. They are not additional ShittimChest license conditions, bot instructions, or a new bot persona, and do not transfer AstrBot's product or service commitments to this project. The project retains its AGPL-3.0-or-later source license and the applicable MIT notices. Preserving the original statements does not resolve every question about their scope; do not describe the whole work as MIT.

Hashes are over original pinned Git blob bytes. The source-baseline.json records 49 selected source, metadata, test, and notice files; it does not assert that all are copied into the application. Root licenses do not establish licensing for unselected plugins, optional skills or third-party dependencies.
